content.short: Bankr is a conversational onchain agent for trading, launching tokens and treasury automation.
content.description: Bankr executes on-chain actions from natural language, covering trades, token launches and recurring treasury operations. Conversational interfaces lower the barrier to acting on-chain considerably, which cuts both ways when the action is irreversible and the instruction was ambiguous.
content.meta: Execute trades, token launches and treasury tasks onchain by describing them in plain language.
